title: Orders module security review

items.short: Division by zero when orders is empty
Money handled as binary float (should be Decimal/cents)
status not validated against an allowlist
Broken object-level authorization / IDOR (user_id trusted fr
Raw DB errors leak to caller (no sanitization/chaining)
Rounding is a policy decision not applied (fractional cents
Fragile positional tuple indexing (sqlite3.Row / name access
